name: nf-tax-records
description: Establish selected Australian tax-record obligations for Norfolk Island taxpayers in 2026. Use for business records, expense substantiation, capital gains evidence, mainland-connected GST, electronic retention and record failures. Covers distinct five-year clocks, extended review periods, delayed credits, the Norfolk acquisition-date exception, loss reconstruction and separate administrative penalties. Includes primary legislation, current authority guidance and fictional boundary cases. Requires the actual entity, obligation, transaction, return and dispute dates before selecting a retention period. Preserves applicable workflow controls and routes company, employment, superannuation and specialist records to their own references. This draft does not authorise record disposal or complete the country pack.
